description: A tool for developers and QA — web interface for viewing and managing database connections
OpenSearch Dashboards, the web UI for OpenSearch search, dashboards and visualizations. Hardened by QuenchWorks as a minimal, nonroot, 0-CVE image, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

Hardened search with a UI in one install: OpenSearch (search and analytics engine, HA cluster or one node) + OpenSearch Dashboards (Discover, dashboards, visualizations, Dev Tools) wired to it. Every image is QuenchWorks-hardened, nonroot, 0-CVE, pinned by digest and cosign-signed.
